summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for worsening headaches, abdominal pain, and right calf pain. Imaging showed no acute intracranial or abdominal pathology; the headache was attributed to neck muscle spasms, and abdominal pain was likely due to a gastric ulcer. Her rapamycin level was elevated, prompting a dose reduction. Diabetes was diagnosed with an A1c of 7.5%, likely steroid-induced, and NPH insulin was initiated. Symptoms improved during the stay, and she was discharged home with updated medications and follow-up plans for oncology, ophthalmology, and endocrinology.
